metadata.description: Marketplace for coding-workflow skills for Claude Code.

plugins.name: dev-skills
plugins.description: Three coding-workflow pipelines (skills + agents) for Claude Code, from raw idea to cut release: project-spec (create-project-spec), build (build-tasks), and release (release-product) — plus setup-production-environment for going live, commit, generate-mockups, optimize-dev (a periodic hygiene pass: backlog grooming + test-suite cost audit), and audit-skills (a by-hand retrospective on how the skills themselves behaved). Each skill responds and thinks in whatever language you address it in.
